metadata.description: Write English text in Apple's own voice — across marketing, interface and documentation surfaces.

plugins.name: apple-writing
plugins.description: Routes any piece of English text to the right Apple register — marketing, interface or editorial — and rewrites it with the word choice, sentence shape and evidence rules Apple actually publishes. Covers product pages, buttons and error messages, READMEs, reports, emails, legal text, and single-word surfaces, with a mechanical style checker, a Vale style and an eval suite.
